mapper.sql: id, name, description, category, tags, graph_json, param_schema_json, operator, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_blueprint (name, description, category, tags, graph_json, param_schema_json, operator, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{category}, #{tags}, #{graphJson}, #{paramSchemaJson}, #{operator}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow_blueprint SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, category = #{category}, tags = #{tags}, graph_json = #{graphJson}, param_schema_json = #{paramSchemaJson}, operator = #{operator}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM workflow_blueprint ORDER BY name
